acceptance.item: P6-MERGE-C-01: M7 beat 2 and a t10/scene.ts comment say a Wythoff polytope's shape depends only on the ringed nodes (sibling of P6-RT-09-03)
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/content-m7-wythoff.test.ts > B3 (0,1,1) and (0,2,1) ring the same nodes and have the same faces but not the same shape, and M7 says so; > no source file of the site says the shape of the polytope depends only on the ringed nodes
acceptance.evidence: Severity minor. Red at base d8102c0: 2 failed. Beat 2 printed 'its shape depends only on which nodes are ringed' against the engine's f-vector (24,36,14,1) for both rings, with squared edge lengths [2,4] against [2,16] from wythoffEdges, solve and formValue. The site-wide scan found m7-geometry.mdx and t10/scene.ts. Cause: 'shape' was used where SPEC 2.14 says combinatorics. The same sentence was also in M7's Seen statement, fixed in the same commit. Beat 2 now says 'its faces depend only on which nodes are ringed, its edge lengths on the rings too' (M7 at 1799 of 1800 words). The Seen statement says 'whose faces depend' and the comment says 'the faces depend'. Green: 2 passed, and content-m7-finite-type.test.ts 3 passed. Its SEEN2 stem follows the new words and its assertions are unchanged. Commit 2a128e0.

acceptance.item: P6-MERGE-C-03: glossary row 64's added sentence on edge lengths has no provenance
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/content-glossary-wythoff.test.ts > the sentence on edge lengths carries its provenance, and the computation it names holds
acceptance.evidence: Severity minor. Red at base: 1 failed, 'the sentence on edge lengths lies in a data-claim span: ... expected undefined to be defined'. Cause: the sentence was added outside every data-claim span. Fix: its words are unchanged, and it now stands in a data-claim span with the fact it rests on (SPEC 2.14 [V]): the edge to the firing of a ringed node i has squared length 2d_ia_i^2, verified by computation on A3, B3, C3, D4, F4, G2 and E6, the boards of verify.py's check and M7 beat 5. The test repeats that computation with the engine: fire, solve and formValue on 3 choices of rings per board, 0 failures. The cited span and the P6-RT-09-03 assertions are unchanged. Green: 2 passed. The M10 provenance test passed in the M10.spec run. Commit 4fb967e.

History now says 'a connected board with roads both ways and whole-number road counts'. Green: 2 passed. content-confusions-node-city (P6-RT-08-07) and content-history-de08-hypothesis (P6-RT-09-02) pass, and T14.spec.ts passes (31, bridge test included). Commit cba0967.
